reviews.t: Love it BUT patience is Important!
reviews.x: Long story short: IM OBSESSED and LOVE this purchase.  Okay so let's talk on this! First of all everything was included, functioning, and as expected. Yes the tubes are smaller but this is a starter kit and each tube can do a few sets of nails depending on length.  Next, THERE ARE INSTRUCTIONS IN THE BOX. Did I read them? No. Did I look at the little pictures and then wing it? Yes.  It is noteworthy that there isn't a lot of slip solution but isopropyl alcohol will work just fine if you find you
Everything came on time which I appreciate. Everything is here looks great and very anxious to try it out

So I love the colors, I love the utensils and the UV light but the polygel is too sticky and hard to form compared to the Gelish Polygel. It does harden pretty fast once under the light which is a plus and the colors come out beautifully but starting and forming is the hardest because it loosens up quick even with a tiny bit of slip solution.

Honestly only took a couple times to learn how much gel to put on each nail, once I layered it three times it became somewhat like a real nail but any pressure and it would bend and snap. It’s a messy product because it’s tacky/paste like and I don’t like that it needs buffed off rather than soaked because buffing it really hurts and it took like 20 min to buff one nail. Over all not too bad, it came with a lot for the price.  Would not buy again though.

The kit came with zero instructions on how to use any of the products, luckily I watched a ton of YouTube tutorials before hand. The gel was hard to work with, and took me a few tries to get my nails not snapping off instantly. The tubes of gel are small, and easy to go through quickly if you don’t know what you’re doing. Nottt a terrible kit for the price, but wouldn’t recommend for first time.

reviews.t: I really like the Polygel kit
reviews.x: I am not a professional and this is the first time I've used a product like this. The Polygel absolutely works as I hoped. It beautifully fixed a broken fingernail and it is not even noticeable! I like the Polygel kit and I would order Coscelia products again. However, I will mention that the LED Lamp cannot be used with an AC Adapter in USA.

reviews.t: Great kit  for beginners like me !
reviews.x: Quick review, I'm in the process of trying the product.  The product came in a small box packaged neatly . I like that its a small 15 ml tube for the poligel . claims.text: Several reviewers report the included lamp did not work or had issues.
Many reviewers find the polygel sticky, tacky, or hard to form and work with.
Reviewers praise the colors and that the kit includes everything needed to get started.
Some reviewers note durability problems, with nails bending or snapping under pressure.
A few reviewers complain about missing or inadequate instructions and missing listed colors.
